Guides

Profile management center

Create, Edit, Delete and Use from one full-screen keyboard interface. Selection is exploration, not activation.

Terminal
ghostty-wall
# Equivalent:
ghostty-wall tui

Find your way around#

In an interactive terminal, keys act immediately: no Enter after each shortcut. First launch offers initialization; the main screen starts on Profiles.

KeyAction
nCreate: Generate or Image, review, Save, then Use now / Not now
eEdit a visual draft; confirmed Save and use
xDelete with default-Cancel confirmation and protected Welcome fallback
aUse selected Profile and stay in the management center
↑ / ↓, j / kSelect and automatically preview without applying
TabSwitch Profiles / Sources; Enter on a Source starts Profile creation
p / EnterEnlarge/restore the sample on compact layouts; not required to preview
?Actions: Sources, duplicate/rename, History, Previous, Doctor, updates and maintenance
vFull result/error details
q / Ctrl-CQuit

Automatic, read-only Profile preview#

The initial and every arrow-selected Profile preview automatically. In Ghostty, a bounded full-color image appears behind representative text using Kitty graphics. Managed fit, position, repeat, opacity and image alpha are composed with the matching resolved colors, including random Profiles. The sample shows foreground/background, all 16 ANSI colors, cursor and selection. It is approximate, not live Ghostty reload; it does not execute a shell or capture your terminal.

Wallpaper blending uses linear-light sRGB, preserving saved opacity and RGB values. This models Ghostty’s linear/linear-corrected blending (the Linux default), not an inferred effective setting. Native blending, Display P3 and user overrides can differ. Font, blur and desktop transparency are not simulated; synthetic 8×16-pixel cells make geometry approximate. Zero opacity hides the photo, and arbitrary low-contrast/transparent recipes cannot guarantee recognition.

Unmanaged colors use neutral illustrative colors. Omitted image settings are illustrated as cover/center/no-repeat/opacity 1.0, not discovered from Ghostty. An unmanaged wallpaper is unknown and not shown; explicitly disabled wallpaper is labelled separately. Unsupported graphics show a labelled color-cell fallback, not photographic proof. Missing/corrupt images and unavailable Sources show errors without disabling navigation; v explains limitations and errors.

Preparation runs off the input loop, with one running request and one replaceable pending selection. Obsolete results cannot replace the current pane; navigation and quit remain available while loading. Repainting does not resolve again; resize reuses the resolved image while local inputs are unchanged. Successful samples watch local Profile/config/selected-image/source-root metadata. Reselect to retry an error or refresh remote content. There is no persisted preview cache.

Browsing leaves saved Profiles, Projection and History unchanged and requests no reload. Only explicit Use activates the selected Profile. Save, Activation and best-effort reload are separate outcomes; reload success is not proof of visible change. The [active] marker comes from the latest Profile Activation (compact lists use *); History replay does not invent an active Profile.

Small terminals#

The management browser supports 60×18 and larger, with list and automatic sample visible together even when compact. No preview key is required; p/Enter can enlarge it. Long IDs are elided in the list and the selected ID appears in the header. Below this management minimum, resize guidance and Esc/Ctrl-C cancellation remain available. Create/Edit forms retain their separate 40×12 minimum and compact sample toggle.

Forms stay inside the interface#

Creation, visual editing, nested image picking, direct import (N), Source-based creation (m or Enter on a Source), rename/duplicate (r/d) and deletion remain full-screen. The localized Downloads/Pictures picker supports arrows, Enter, d/p roots, /text search and path:/absolute/path. Esc returns without importing.

Input forms retain values after validation errors: Enter advances/submits the last field, Tab/Shift-Tab revisits fields, Ctrl-U clears, F1 shows full errors, and Esc/Ctrl-C/Ctrl-D cancels. Creation saves before optional Use now; visual editing requires confirmed Save and use. Advanced f/c/t/w field edits save immediately without applying. Deletion shows the exact prepared summary; only y confirms, while Enter/n/Esc/Ctrl-C/Ctrl-D declines. Protected Welcome, active fallback and image-ownership checks still apply.

Non-terminal input retains the legacy line-based browser (key then Enter); it is not a fallback within a full-screen session.

Maintenance, reports and updates#

First-start initialization and all Actions stay full-screen: Source add/inspection (including GitHub ref/subdirectory fields), List, History, Settings, Plan JSON, Doctor, Previous, update check/install, initialization/dry-run/repair/Welcome, migration/dry-run and Uninstall. Source administration means add and inspect, not rename or remove. Reports scroll with arrows/PageUp/PageDown; Enter/Esc/q returns after completion and v revisits details. Captured reports are bounded to 4 MiB, with truncation disclosed.

Maintenance mutations require explicit y; Enter/n/Esc/Ctrl-C/Ctrl-D declines. Long jobs stream progress off the input thread. Esc can close a read-only view, but its work may finish in the background; another maintenance read-only job must wait for it. After a mutation starts, cancellation is unavailable until completion/recovery: wait rather than terminating the process. Uninstall preserves Intent/History and returns to the browser, with Initialize/Repair available.

Check and Install update are separate Actions using the same safe updater as the CLI. Progress, failures and recovery instructions stay in the report. After replacement, restart Ghostty Wall; the running process retains its old version. i opens the original wallpaper inside the interface using Ghostty graphics, with a text fallback elsewhere. This is not the Profile-opacity sample or live reload.

Random profiles#

Terminal
ghostty-wall tui --seed 000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f

A random Profile gets an automatic session preview seed, reused by Use. Pass an explicit 64-hex seed to reproduce a selection; nonrandom Profiles do not receive one. External Source changes can still change resolution.
